entries.name: Bloom Energy
entries.thesis_fit: Solid-oxide fuel cells / on-site generation; potential beneficiary of AI/data-center power demand and broader electrification — fits open energy theme under stocks/growth.

entries.name: Alphabet (Google)
entries.thesis_fit: Full AI stack exposure: cloud (GCP), foundation models (Gemini), search/ads cash engine, YouTube, and infra. Fits open AI theme under ~60% stocks/growth sleeve as a liquid mega-cap candidate — not on agentic core allowlist.

entries.name: Apple
entries.thesis_fit: Device + services mega-cap with AI on-device / ecosystem angle (Apple Intelligence), high cash generation, and broad consumer reach. Fits open AI/growth theme under ~60% stocks/growth — liquid candidate, not on agentic core allowlist.

entries.name: NVIDIA
entries.thesis_fit: Dominant AI accelerator / data-center GPU franchise; primary pure-play on AI training/inference infra under ~60% stocks/growth. High liquidity mega-cap; not on agentic core allowlist by default. 2026-08-23: own open-source/open-weight models may reinforce that GPU franchise via vertical integration / industry lock-in (note only; not a price target or position).

entries.name: Palantir Technologies
entries.thesis_fit: Optional listed harness + applications sleeve (AIP/Ontology ≈ enterprise context/decision OS). Fills public-book gap vs silicon+BTC+energy; does NOT advance ASIC/Turo engines, Energy, Bitcoin, or Robotics. Thesis-only fit: yes as sleeve, no as core.

entries.name: EVgo, Inc.
entries.thesis_fit: Public DCFC / EV charging infrastructure; moderate Energy/electrification fit. Owner catalyst 2026-08-06: white-label Tesla V4 Superchargers (EVgo-owned/branded) may improve utilization and Tesla-driver discovery. Weaker Energy expression than BE (AI power equipment); adjacent to held TSLA. Show-me story — chart multi-year weak; charging growth real, Adj. EBITDA still negative.

entries.name: Amazon.com
entries.thesis_fit: Liquid mega-cap AWS + retail + ads under ~60% stocks/growth; not on agentic core allowlist.

entries.name: Anduril Industries
entries.thesis_fit: Software-defined defense autonomy (Lattice, UAVs, C-UAS, undersea, soldier systems). Primary owner rank #1. Fits Autonomy + Robotics + AI physical-world leverage under stocks/growth when/if public. Concentration and defense-cycle risk will dominate any first-size decision.
entries.next_catalyst: IPO process milestones or next major funding/valuation print; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06

entries.name: Saronic Technologies
entries.thesis_fit: Autonomous surface vessels + shipyard scale (Port Alpha narrative) for hybrid naval fleets. Owner rank #2. Pure-play maritime autonomy under Autonomy/Robotics when/if public; execution and shipbuilding capacity are the binding risks.
entries.next_catalyst: Program awards, shipyard milestones, or funding/IPO process news; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06

entries.name: Boom Supersonic
entries.thesis_fit: Dual path: (1) Overture supersonic airliner + Symphony engine heritage; (2) owner note 2026-08-06 — jet-turbine development repurposed toward data-center buildout power generation (AI/power demand). Owner rank #3. Energy + AI-power sleeve now the primary north-star link; aerospace remains secondary optionality. Still high technical / capital / execution risk vs pure-play power names.
entries.next_catalyst: Power-gen / data-center turbine milestones or Overture flight/engine news; no confirmed IPO date as of 2026-08-06
